title: Aoyagi Toya — After-School Assistance〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Rehearsal Room

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay, we'll start playing the songs we wrote.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I can't wait to hear what they're like!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, me too!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We'll begin with the street song Aoyagi wrote. Hit it, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay, here's the first song!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Wow...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, this is...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What did you all think?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I thought it was super duper amazingly good♪
I got really excited just listening to it☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I could especially feel the effort you put into the intro!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, it doesn't immediately feel like a street song. You did an excellent job of making it fun and intriguing for the listener.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I had a really easy time imagining how I'm gonna sing it! I feel like I can throw everything I have into it!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Then...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you for making this. I know I asked a lot of you, and I'd like to use this song as-is.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Congratulations, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (This wouldn't have been possible without the help of Saki and Hoshino. I also need to thank Azusawa and the others, who listened to it so many times...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, next, we have the pop song I wrote just for you, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm very glad that all of our songs have been approved.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Me too♪ At the same time, it's kinda sad that we're already done writing songs for this.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I understand how you feel.
All that's left is for us to make adjustments if the need arises.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I can't relax just yet. I still have to work on playing my character.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, right!
The hard part might just be beginning for you, Ichi.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Certainly...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The other teams likely have a lot on their hands, so it may be good for us to go over and see how we can help.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, it could be fun to see what the other teams are doing and help them out♪

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akiyama from the costume design team is in my class, so perhaps I'll ask if there's anything I can do to help.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Then, I'll try asking the other teams to see if they need a hand!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We're not done yet, songwriters. Let's keep helping out until the end.

rows.Speaker: Ichika & Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Okay!
After school
Kamiyama High School - Class 2-B

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: ...which is why you're asking if there's anything you can do to help?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Is there anything I can do right this moment?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, tons!
Especially the band's outfits, since we have to make enough for all of them.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I need you to put these pieces of fabric together using marking pins.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I can handle that.
I remember doing the same thing very well during class.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Thanks, you're a lifesaver!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, while you get those ready, I'm gonna keep working on the costumes An and the others will be wearing.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Are these them?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup! I'm about to sew these buttons and jewels onto them♪

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This costume... It looks like something you'd find in a store.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I know very little about fashion, but I can tell that it's been made with great care.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. You've got a good eye. I do this as a hobby, but even I can make stuff like this if I really put my mind to it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, this is quite impressive.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm sure Shiraishi and the others are going to really enjoy wearing these on stage.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whoa, slow down. You're gonna make me blush if you keep showering me with praise like that.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: These are actually almost done, so you're probably gonna be the first to see them once they're fully finished.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That's quite an honor.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Alright, until then, I'll focus on the work you've set for me.
